'''Haf Mandrox''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] for [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThug.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Haf Mandrox]]
Haf Mandrox was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Haf Mandrox spawned under the generic "thug" template, his appearance was randomized under one of thirty-five possible depictions. [[Species/Legends|Species]] Haf Mandrox could appear as included [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] under either [[Gender/Legends|gender]]. Because the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Mandrox as a Human male, this article assumes that one of the three randomly generated Human male depictions is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
